variants.idea: Remove corner and central givens so fewer rows, columns and boxes are nearly complete.
Remove scattered givens to weaken the easy singles and force longer chains.
Remove edge givens, leaving fewer direct eliminations along rows and columns.
Thin out the givens in the lower-left and middle-left areas to lengthen deductions.
Break up the nearly complete row 8 and the left side.
Remove givens that give quick singles in row 2 and the box and row corners.
Remove givens in the left columns so no column or box is close to complete.
Remove givens from different boxes to spread the difficulty and make deductions longer.
Remove edge givens that anchor easy singles, leaving the grid sparser.
Break up the dense row 8 and central clues so more cross-unit reasoning is needed.
